# Demo Playwright JavaScript for Google Search

> A beginner-friendly Playwright + JavaScript demo that describes driving a
> real Chromium browser against the real, live Google Search website
> (https://www.google.com) and running three real assertion-based checks.
> Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of its services, so
> this repo's code must never be executed against live google.com in CI or
> automated tooling — see AGENTS.md.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Install instructions, the Google ToS caution, and a summary of what the demo tests.
- [Spec](spec/index.md): The exact three test scenarios, selectors, and expected strings, as the single source of truth.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Source-of-truth pointer and the non-negotiable against live execution.
- [Citation](CITATION.cff): Citation metadata for this software.

## Source

- [demo.js](src/demo.js): The Playwright script that implements the three tests described in the spec.

## Optional

- [Google Search](https://www.google.com): The live website this demo describes testing against (do not automate against it).
- [Live examples page](https://testingexamples.github.io/examples/google-search/): The testingexamples.github.io page documenting the same caution and interaction pattern.
